subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What canonical user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing google-vertex provider while keeping the provider id and model route stable?
rationale: The source change is small, but choosing between the reporter's proposed label and Google's current docs wording is product/UI copy direction rather than a deterministic bug fix.

options.title: Use Google docs bridge wording
options.body: Display the provider as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI) or similarly bridged copy while keeping google-vertex as the stable id.

options.title: Use reporter wording
options.body: Display the provider as Google Enterprise AI, accepting that it does not match the current Google documentation phrasing as closely.

options.title: Keep current label
options.body: Keep Google Vertex AI until maintainers decide the old brand is clearer for users and docs.

recommendation.title: Use Google docs bridge wording
recommendation.body: Display the provider as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI) or similarly bridged copy while keeping google-vertex as the stable id.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is public UI/docs wording, and the issue discussion specifically routed that label decision toward this handle.
